about: Renders a navigation landmark of page buttons between the buttons that move a page back and forward. Every page and trigger is the library's square button, and the current page is the button marked on.

edges.about: The first and last triggers jump to the ends. With `siblingCount` 0 the row shows the first, the current and the last page between them.
edges.title: Edges

links.about: With `type="link"`, every page and trigger is a link to the address `getPageUrl` returns, so a reader can open a page in a new tab and the address bar keeps the page. A press follows the link and leaves the page to the address: the example reads `page` from the hash, as an application reads it from its router.
links.title: Links

looks.about: The root passes `variant` to every button. Ghost and outline fill the current page, and subtle fills it one step deeper than the other pages.
looks.title: Looks

narrow.about: The root measures whether its pages fit the row. When they do not, it sets `data-crowded`, the pages and marks are hidden, and the summary states the current page between the triggers. The `summary` prop of `Pagination.Items` sets the summary's words.
narrow.title: Narrow

palette.about: The root passes `palette` to every button, so the current page takes the palette's fill.
palette.title: Palettes

siblings.about: `siblingCount` sets how many pages show on each side of the current one. Every row starts on page 12 of 24, where marks replace the runs of pages left out.
siblings.title: Siblings

size.about: Every size. The size sets the buttons, the gaps between them, the ellipsis and the page text.
size.title: Sizes

table.about: A controlled pagination under a list: the caller keeps `page` and `pageSize`, shows the rows of the current page, and changes the page size from a segment group. The page text gives the range of rows.
table.title: Controlled

text.about: The page text in each format: compact states the page, short gives the page over the count, and long gives the range of items. It is an `output`, so a screen reader reads the new text after a press.
text.title: Page text

title: Pagination
